title: Robin Williams’ Daughter Calls for Fans Creating AI Videos of the Actor to ‘Have Some Shame’: ‘Leave Him Out of Your Delusional Bulls—’
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Zelda Williamsis calling for fans to stop circulating AI-generated videos of her late father,Robin Williams,nearly a year aftershe last took to social media to ask them not to send her augmented content featuring the actor.

In a statement posted toXon Monday, the “Lisa Frankenstein” director wrote that a “supposedly ‘private video’” circulating of her father “is clearly AI, and not even particularly convincing AI,” she wrote. “Anyone who claims to be a fan who believes it clearly listened to his movies on mute because that voice is robotic and terrible. That said, a human made a robot create it, and to you I say: leave him out of your delusional bullshit and let him rest. If you cannot make your case without making a dead man make it more convincing for you, then tell me: who’s the one manipulating the public thru media now?”

Zelda continued: “I hate this cesspool of an app. It’s mostly bots and people willingly being duped by bots at this point so not sure why I feel the need to come back to clarify, but I love him, so I will. Just because he’s gone does not mean he’s now your puppet. Have some shame.”

The iconic comedian, who starred in films including “Jumanji,” “Good Will Hunting,” “Dead Poets Society,” “Hook,” “Mrs. Doubtfire,” and more, died in 2014 at the age of 63. In recent years, his likeness has become a popular target for AI recreation as users continue to create and share augmented videos of the actor.

This isn’t the first time Zelda has voiced her feelings about AI; Back in Oct. 2025, she wrote “Please, just stop sending me AI videos of Dad” on Instagram. “Stop believing I wanna see it or that I’ll understand, I don’t and I won’t. If you’re just trying to troll me, I’ve seen way worse, I’ll restrict and move on. But please, if you’ve got any decency, just stop doing this to him and to me, to everyone even, full stop. It’s dumb, it’s a waste of time and energy, and believe me, it’s NOT what he’d want.”

Just last month, sherevived her father’s Instagram accountwith siblings Zak and Cody in an attempt to “fight back against rampant AI abuse of his voice and likeness on here.”

title_zh: 羅賓·威廉斯(Robin Williams)的女兒呼籲粉絲們停止創作有關這位演員的人工智慧影片，並表示「要有點羞恥心：把他留在你們的妄想之外。」
content_zh:
佩頓·圖克塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

澤爾達·威廉斯(Zelda Williams)呼籲粉絲停止傳播她已故父親羅賓·威廉斯(Robin Williams)的AI生成影片，距離她上次在社交媒體上要求大家不要發送包含這位演員的增強內容已經快一年了。

在週一發佈於X的聲明中，這位《莉莎·弗蘭肯斯坦》(Lisa Frankenstein)導演寫道，流傳的“所謂‘私人影片’”顯然是AI生成的，甚至連說服力都不強。她表示：“任何聲稱是粉絲的人如果相信這個，顯然是把他的電影靜音來看，因為那聲音聽起來機械而可怕。話雖如此，還是有人讓機器人創造了這個影片，對你們我想說：讓他遠離你們的妄想胡言，讓他安息。如果你們不能在不讓一個死去的人為你們的論點增添說服力的情況下提出論點，那麼告訴我：現在誰才是在通過媒體操控公眾？”

澤爾達接著說：“我討厭這個糞坑般的應用程式。現在大多是機器人和自願被機器人欺騙的人，所以不太確定為什麼我覺得需要回來澄清，但我愛他，所以我會這麼做。僅僅因為他已經不在了，並不意味著他現在是你們的木偶。要有點羞恥心。”

這位標誌性的喜劇演員曾出演過《侏羅紀公園》(Jumanji)、《心靈捕手》(Good Will Hunting)、《死亡詩社》(Dead Poets Society)、《鉤子》(Hook)、《窈窕淑女》(Mrs. Doubtfire)等多部電影，於2014年去世，享年63歲。近年來，他的形象成為AI重現的熱門對象，使用者不斷創作並分享這位演員的增強影片。

這並不是澤爾達第一次表達對AI的看法；在2025年10月，她在Instagram上寫道：“請，停止給我發爸爸的AI影片。”她說：“別再相信我想看這些或我會理解，我不想也不會。如果你只是想來惹我，我見過更糟的，我會限制並繼續前進。但請，如果你有任何體面，請停止對他和我，甚至對所有人這樣做，停止。這是愚蠢的，浪費時間和精力，信我，這不是他想要的。”

就在上個月，她和兄弟扎克(Zak)及科迪(Cody)一起恢復了她父親的Instagram帳號，試圖“反擊這裡對他聲音和形象的肆虐AI濫用”。

那個我被展示的所謂‘私人影片’，裡面爸爸在談論陰謀論，顯然是AI生成的，甚至連說服力都不強。任何聲稱是粉絲的人如果相信這個，顯然是把他的電影靜音來看，因為那聲音聽起來機械而可怕。
